je_pmr_ammoniacal_liquor_inception = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	is_shown_when_inactive = { can_research = ammoniacal_liquor }
	possible = { can_research = ammoniacal_liquor }

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_ammoniacal_liquor

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_ammoniacal_liquor)" >= 36 }
	}

	on_complete = {
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = ammoniacal_liquor }
			add_technology_progress = { progress = 5000  technology = ammoniacal_liquor }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = ammoniacal_liquor }
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_pmr_ammoniacal_liquor_development }
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_JE|inception|ammoniacal_liquor|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}

	invalid = { has_technology_researched = ammoniacal_liquor }

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_destroyer

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_destroyer)" >= 26 }
	}

	on_complete = {
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = destroyer }
			add_technology_progress = { progress = 8750  technology = destroyer }
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation|destroyer|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}

	invalid = { has_technology_researched = destroyer }

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_high_speed_papermaking

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_high_speed_papermaking)" >= 36 }
	}

	on_complete = {
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = high_speed_papermaking }
			add_technology_progress = { progress = 8750  technology = high_speed_papermaking }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = high_speed_papermaking }
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_pmr_high_speed_papermaking_implementation }
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_JE|development|high_speed_papermaking|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}

	invalid = { has_technology_researched = high_speed_papermaking }

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_kraft_process

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_kraft_process)" >= 36 }
	}

	on_complete = {
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = kraft_process }
			add_technology_progress = { progress = 6250  technology = kraft_process }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = kraft_process }
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_pmr_kraft_process_implementation }
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_JE|development|kraft_process|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}

	invalid = { has_technology_researched = kraft_process }

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_superheated_steam

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_superheated_steam)" >= 36 }

		if = {
			limit = { can_research = superheated_steam }

		}
		debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation|superheated_steam|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"

	invalid = { has_technology_researched = superheated_steam }

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
